Package com.hathoute.lib.openelastic.opensearch

Class OpenSearchDocumentSearch

java.lang.Object
com.hathoute.lib.openelastic.opensearch.OpenSearchDocumentSearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
DocumentSearch, AutoCloseable
public final class OpenSearchDocumentSearch extends Object implements DocumentSearch
DocumentSearch backed by the official opensearch-java client (built on the Apache HttpClient 5 based low-level REST client).
